name: Regulation (EU) 2025/38 strengthening solidarity and capacities in the Union to detect, prepare for and respond to cybersecurity threats and incidents
description: Establishes a European Cybersecurity Alert System (interconnected National and Cross-Border Cyber Hubs) and a Cybersecurity Emergency Mechanism (stockpiling, incident response support, mutual assistance).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by European Union (europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within European Union (europa.eu).
